headline: Congress on Summer Recess—Both Chambers in Pro Forma Mode with No Floor Action on Thursday

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate met in pro forma session for just 28 seconds Thursday morning, adjourning quickly without taking any substantive action. The chamber will remain in this minimal-activity posture until returning to regular business next week.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House convened briefly at 9 a.m. and adjourned at 9:03 a.m. in pro forma session, introducing 27 new bills and 3 resolutions but conducting no recorded votes. Speaker appointed Rep. Foxx as Speaker pro tempore for the day.
